## Why This Is Asked
In multi-tenant KCNA deployments, tamper-evident audit trails enable compliance, forensics, and governance without sacrificing performance.

## Key Concepts
- Append-only per-tenant logs and digest chaining
- Merkle proofs for cross-checks and tamper evidence
- Cryptographic signing and secure key rotation
- Canary-driven rollout and safe rollback

## Code Example
```javascript
function verifyBatch(batch, root) {
  const digest = hash(batch);
  const proof = getMerkleProof(batch.id);
  return Merkle.verify(digest, proof, root);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How to scale verification and audit dashboards?
- How to handle key compromise and revocation?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design secure, low-latency policy enforcement at the data plane with tenant isolation and auditability; assesses WASM sandboxing, policy language, and testing.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant isolation via per-tenant sandboxes
- WASM sandboxes with resource quotas
- Per-tenant policy language and policy compilation
- End-to-end auditing and tamper-evident logs
- Latency budgeting and measurement

## Code Example
```javascript
// Inline sandboxed policy evaluator (high level)
function evaluate(tenantId, event, policies) {
  const policy = policies[tenantId];
  const res = sandbox.run(policy, event); // sandboxed VM
  return res.allowed;
}
```

}
